newsitem.title: CHINA: China average employee salary up 12.9 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China average employee salary up 12.9 pct in 1996.

text.p: The average salary of Chinese employees hit 6,210 yuan ($748) in 1996, up 12.9 percent from the 1995 level, the official Wen Hui Bao newspaper said on Thursday.

With retail price inflation factored in, the actual increase in 1996 was 3.8 percent, the newspaper quoted China's State Statistical Bureau as saying, adding it was the most moderate increase since 1992.
The total salary income of Chinese employees amounted to 912 billion yuan in 1996, up 12.6 percent from the 1995 level, the newspaper said.
It said China was working to reduce the gap in salary levels between different industries and to slow down the dramatic growth in non-salary income.
